subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 8: Skills – Listening, speaking and writing a blog post
outcomes: Listen for details about an astronaut's life.
Talk about what you will do on the ISS using will.
Write a blog post with questions and correct punctuation.

tf.s: Astronaut Ali's blog post is about food on the ISS.
tf.why: Ali writes about food on the ISS.

tf.s: Astronauts eat a lot of biscuits and cakes on the ISS.
tf.why: They don't, because crumbs float around.

tf.s: Astronauts have three meals a day.
tf.why: They have three meals a day.

tf.s: We put a question mark (?) at the end of a question.
tf.why: Questions end with a question mark.

tf.s: Writers use questions to make a blog post more interesting.
Astronauts wear a spacesuit outside the ISS because it is very hot.
tf.why: They wear it because there is no air to breathe in space.

tf.s: From the ISS, astronauts can see rivers, mountains and oceans on Earth.
tf.why: They can see them from the window.

tf.s: A blog post has no topic.
tf.why: A blog post has a topic, like food or clothes.

tf.s: "What do astronauts eat." is correct punctuation.
tf.why: It is a question, so it needs a question mark: What do astronauts eat?

tf.s: A blog post can start with: My blog post today is about …

boxes.q: What is Astronaut Ali's blog post about?
boxes.why: Ali's blog post is about food.

o: They have a lot of crumbs which float around.
boxes.why: Crumbs float in space and cause problems.

boxes.q: How many meals a day do astronauts have?
boxes.why: Astronauts have three meals a day.

boxes.q: Which punctuation mark ends a question?
boxes.why: A question ends with a question mark.

boxes.q: What can we see from the ISS?
boxes.why: We can see rivers, mountains and oceans on Earth.

boxes.q: Why do astronauts wear a spacesuit outside the ISS?
o: There is no air to breathe.
boxes.why: There is no air in space.

boxes.q: Complete: What will you do if you need to wash your hair? I ______ use a little water.
Which is a good topic for an astronaut's blog post?
Which sentence starts a blog post?
boxes.why: Start by saying who you are.

boxes.q: Find the question in Ali's blog post.
o: We eat three meals a day.
boxes.why: It is the sentence with a question mark.

hunt.q: Meals a day on the ISS
Food with a lot of crumbs
Mark at the end of a question
Blog post start: My blog post today is ___

mcq.q: Which features does a blog post have?
mcq.why: A blog post has a topic, questions and information.

mcq.q: What do we use at the end of a question?
Which topics can an astronaut write about?
mcq.why: These are the topics in the lesson.

mcq.q: What can astronauts see from the ISS?
o: rivers, mountains and oceans on Earth
mcq.why: They can see these from space.

mcq.q: What will you do if you need to wash your hair on the ISS?
o: I'll use a little water and a towel.
mcq.why: Water floats, so a little water and a towel is best.

mcq.q: Choose the correct sentence for a blog post.
o: Did you know that astronauts sleep in bags?
Did you know that astronauts sleep in bags.
did you know that astronauts sleep in bags?
Did you knows that astronauts sleep in bags?
mcq.why: Capital letter at the start and a question mark at the end.

mcq.q: Which is a good first sentence for your blog post?
o: Hi, I'm Astronaut Huda. My blog post today is about clothes.
mcq.why: Say who you are and what the post is about.

mcq.q: Why don't astronauts eat biscuits or cakes on the ISS?
o: Crumbs float around and that is a problem.
Biscuits are too heavy for rockets.

mcq.q: Why do writers use questions in a blog post?
o: To make the writing interesting for readers.
Because they don't know the answers.
mcq.why: Questions make readers want to read more.

mcq.q: Why do astronauts need a spacesuit outside the ISS?
o: There is no air to breathe in space.
It is a uniform for school.
